title: Lightly Smoky Portuguese Chicken Grill
description: A malty and creamy Portuguese dish featuring cloves and grilled to perfection over binchotan charcoal, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This mediterranean friendly recipe is served on a bamboo tray.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan charcoal grill to medium high heat.
In a small bowl, mix together the ground cloves, garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, plain yogurt, and malt vinegar.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and coat with the yogurt mixture.
Sprinkle the clove mixture evenly over the chicken breast.
Place the chicken breast on the bamboo tray and grill for 6 minutes per side.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Grill the bamboo tray over the binchotan charcoal for 2 minutes to get a smoky flavor.
Let the chicken cool slightly before serving.
